description: Asked if the man was hurt, was told you did not know, and stopped at one gate.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Kept the household at the table, and kept Verbeke under his own name.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Said the man was a silkweaver, like himself, and English, and cut his bread smaller.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Reported only what he had seen, and refused a cause he did not have.
name: William Shakespeare
